rules: Standalone signals: no case, entity or map-line links. Incident date kept apart from report date. Pin = the place the source gives; 'approx.' in the title when only a street, suburb or area is known. Sources that reuse one report or one police statement are not independent corroboration. Being near another pin is not a link. Private individuals (victims and suspects) are not named.

signals.title: Steenberg (Military Rd, approx.): two men, 23 and 37, shot dead; five arrested after chase, 20 Oct
signals.content: Police say two men, aged 23 and 37, were fatally wounded in a shooting in Military Road, Steenberg, at about 12:30 on Tuesday 20 October. The suspects fled in a red VW Polo, abandoned it in Kirstenhof after a high-speed chase and hijacked a white Toyota RunX; police arrested five men aged 27 to 40, whom they describe as "gang-affiliated", and recovered two assault rifles from the hijacked car (SAPS Western Cape statement on X, 20 October; Cape Times names the police spokesperson as Constable Ndakhe Gwala). Police did not say where the arrests were made; Smile 90.4FM, in an updated story, says Lakeside, as does Briefly News' account of the mayor's post on X. By that account the mayor gives the weapons as two AK-47 rifles and a 9mm pistol; police name two assault rifles. The suspects were due in the Wynberg Magistrate's Court once charged. No motive was stated. The victims and suspects were not named. Three reports, all resting on the one police statement: Cape Times (IOL), Smile 90.4FM and Briefly News.

signals.title: Strandfontein (Korvette Rd, approx.): man, 26, found shot dead, 19 Oct
signals.content: Police say a man of 26 was found with multiple gunshot wounds in front of a property in Korvette Road, Strandfontein, when officers responded at about 20:45 on Monday 19 October (Lieutenant-Colonel Frederick van Wyk, via Cape Argus and TygerBurger). No source says when he was shot. Strandfontein police registered a murder case; police believe the motive is gang-related. No arrest has been reported. The victim was not named. Two reports, both resting on one police account: TygerBurger and Cape Argus (IOL). Both also describe other Strandfontein shootings on 16 and 17 October; those are not part of this pin.

checked.incident: Mon 19 Oct 2026, found when police responded at about 20:45 (police, via Cape Argus and TygerBurger). 20:45 is the response and discovery time, not a shooting time; no source gives one.
